description: Na₄Si₂Te₅ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are eight inequivalent Na sites. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-9°. There are a spread of Na-Te bond distances ranging from 3.10-3.55 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six Te atoms to form NaTe₆ octahedra that share corners with four NaTe₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaTe₅ square pyramid,  a cornercorner with one SiSiTe₃ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaTe₅ trigonal bipyramid, edges with eight NaTe₆ octahedra, and edges with three SiSiTe₃ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-14°. There are a spread of Na-Te bond distances ranging from 3.21-3.34 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to five Te atoms to form distorted NaTe₅ square pyramids that share corners with five NaTe₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaTe₅ square pyramids, corners with four SiSiTe₃ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaTe₅ trigonal bipyramid, edges with four NaTe₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one SiSiTe₃ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaTe₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-83°. There are a spread of Na-Te bond distances ranging from 3.18-3.30 Å.
